passages.title: HEALTHY MINDS WORKSHOP
passages.content: The Community Health Center is organizing a "Healthy Minds" mental wellness workshop. We encourage every resident to attend this significant event. If everyone (1) ______ their experiences, we will foster a supportive environment in our neighborhood. The main objective is to deepen participants' (2) ______ of emotional well-being. To accomplish this, the center will have interactive booths (3) ______ in the main hall. Furthermore, stress-management seminars will be conducted to instruct residents on how to (4) ______ out negative thoughts effectively. These meetings guarantee that coping strategies are applied properly. We hope to (5) ______ positive attitudes through regular mindfulness exercises. We strongly trust that minor personal adjustments will lead to permanent improvements. Mentors will assist in guiding discussions across every session of the workshop. Please register via our website. Your (6) ______ is vital for the program's prosperity. Do not hesitate – sign up with us right now!

passages.badge: Câu 12–16: Điền vào chỗ trống (đoạn văn)
passages.title: PRODUCTIVITY MYTHS
passages.content:
Among the many myths surrounding productivity, one merits close examination: the efficiency that truly matters is exactly the efficiency you cannot easily measure. When a colleague rapidly switches between browser tabs, it is common (12) ______. A deeper look frequently reveals a contrasting reality. A vast majority of those who juggle multiple tasks are, in truth, only superficial workers (13) ______ to the illusion of being busy. It is difficult to conclude whether someone answering dozens of emails per hour is productive. Yet the undeniable fact is that they have less sustained focus than they did before they started multitasking, or more fragmented thoughts. (14) ______.

We generally evaluate productivity by what we observe since visible actions are the sole proof we can grasp. No one goes around exhibiting a chart of their deep focus hours, (15) ______ – overflowing inboxes, endless meeting schedules, active status lights – to assess who is thriving. Modern workplace culture has nurtured this tendency, framing the appearance of exertion as a valuable trait. (16) ______. It resides in the notification ignored, the unnecessary meeting declined, the instant message left unread, the trivial project never started and the superficial chat gently avoided.

In brief, true productivity is whatever time has not yet been traded for superficial tasks. That is why differentiating busy from productive warrants serious reflection; confusing one for the other has silently destroyed many a career.

passages.title: DIGITAL PRIVACY
passages.content:
It is crucial to emphasize that digital convenience comes with vulnerabilities, even when utilized without malicious intent. All vulnerabilities should be evaluated as privacy costs. The privacy cost for digital convenience is the secure data compromised because the platforms offering the service can no longer guarantee absolute confidentiality. Applications are not risk-free if they can be exploited by third parties.

Take the example of a fitness tracker that can be used either for monitoring heart rates or for sharing workout routes socially. Because the GPS feature that maps the routes would broadcast the user's location, the two functions pose conflicting safety levels. The privacy cost of using the tracker solely for heart monitoring is the social connectivity lost – after factoring in the motivation and community support – for health tracking. On the other hand, the privacy cost of enabling GPS sharing is everything the private data would have secured: the anonymity, the home address, the daily routine, and whatever importance future employers might attach to analyzing health conditions.

This revelation has profound consequences for data regulation. [I] Numerous choices that seem initially to be harmless preferences for connectivity prove, upon detailed scrutiny, to be compromises of something else. [II] Uploading photos to a cloud server is not without risk; it is compensated for in facial recognition data, behavioral profiling, and the tracking metrics the platform gathered invisibly. [III] Syncing a contact list to find friends is not without risk; the toll is whatever the contacts were keeping private before the synchronization. [IV] Even leaving a device on standby is not without risk, for the ambient data that microphones might have captured is sacrificed as well.

Digital engagement, from this perspective, is never merely a matter of whether an app provides a useful feature. It is a matter of whether the utility surpasses the significance of what must be surrendered. Regulations that acknowledge this – by mandating transparency for hidden data collection, or by compelling tech companies to clarify both sides of the agreement – do not oppose innovation. They demand that the technology adopted be justifiable for what it genuinely extracts. The peril lies not in sharing too little, but in sharing too much.

passages.title: WINTER VOLUNTEER CAMP FOR HIGH SCHOOLERS
passages.content: Global Youth Network is thrilled to declare fifty volunteer slots up for (27) ______ this winter. The stronger commitment to community service you demonstrate, (28) ______ favorable your chances are to be chosen! Admitted participants will acquire abundant practical skills, meaningful connections, and exposure to the regional charity network. (29) ______, we provide comprehensive accommodation and transport allowances for those residing in other provinces. In addition, (30) ______ role demands prior background since incoming volunteers are equipped with intensive orientation workshops. Registrations (31) ______ be sent to us at volunteer@gyn.org by 15 November. Seldom has there been such a(n) (32) ______ prospect to launch your journey in social work. Do not let this opportunity pass you by – register now!

passages.title: NUTRITION & METABOLISM
passages.content:
For years, consumers have been persuaded that nutritional health is mostly reliant upon strict calorie counting. What has transformed in recent times is not the relevance of a healthy diet but the metrics used to evaluate it. The focus on food quality has quietly replaced the obsession with quantities, and with it, the perception of how meals are processed by the body has altered unbeknownst to the general public.

Scientists in nutritional biology have started to investigate what this shift has revealed about metabolism. In multiple controlled trials, individuals consuming whole foods consistently exhibited better metabolic responses than those eating ultra-processed alternatives with identical calorie counts, even when both cohorts had identical energy expenditures. The explanation, according to the scientists, relates less to the caloric number itself than to how each food type interacts with the digestive system. Processed food facilitates rapid absorption; whole food necessitates breakdown.

The process of digesting whole foods is more prolonged, and that duration seems to be its concealed benefit. Incapable of absorbing sugars instantly, the body is forced to expend energy, regulate insulin properly and distribute nutrients at a steady pace. This gradual assimilation, known as the thermic effect of food by biologists, proves to be pivotal in maintaining long-term satiety. One nutritionist illustrated the remarkable difference after analyzing her clients' diets: the processed meals, she noted, had triggered energy spikes, whereas the whole foods had provided sustained nourishment.

It would be inaccurate, naturally, to assert that all calorie counting is completely useless or that all processed items ruin health. Disciplined calorie counters can maintain weight, while careless whole-food eaters can overconsume. What the evidence underscores is not a verdict on dietary tracking but an inquiry into food quality: which ingredient, in a specific metabolic context, requires more beneficial effort from the body. As the debate over dietary guidelines remains a subject of controversy among health organizations, the profound obstacle might be assisting consumers in realizing that what tastes more rewarding initially is not always what nourishes them best ultimately.

questions.stem: Choose the best option for blank (1).
questions.explain: Câu điều kiện loại 1 (If + S + V(hiện tại đơn), S + will + V). Chủ ngữ "everyone" là đại từ bất định nên động từ chia ở ngôi thứ 3 số ít.

questions.stem: Choose the best option for blank (2).
questions.explain: Cụm từ "deepen someone's awareness of sth" mang nghĩa là "nâng cao nhận thức của ai đó về việc gì".

questions.stem: Choose the best option for blank (3).
questions.explain: Cấu trúc cầu khiến bị động: have + sth + V3/ed (có cái gì đó được làm bởi ai). "have interactive booths arranged" (có các gian hàng tương tác được sắp xếp).

questions.stem: Choose the best option for blank (4).
questions.explain: Phrasal verb "filter out" nghĩa là sàng lọc, loại bỏ (những suy nghĩ tiêu cực).

questions.stem: Choose the best option for blank (5).
questions.explain: "Cultivate positive attitudes" mang nghĩa là trau dồi, nuôi dưỡng thái độ tích cực.

questions.stem: Choose the best option for blank (6).
questions.explain: Sau tính từ sở hữu "Your" cần một danh từ. "Participation" (sự tham gia) hợp lý nhất về nghĩa.

questions.stem:
Choose the best arrangement of utterances or sentences to make a cohesive and coherent exchange or text.

Dear Ms. Nguyen,
a. To claim your prize, please fill out the enclosed form and return it before August 20th.
b. Your portfolio during the judging phase demonstrates creativity and skill.
c. The award includes a professional camera kit and a cash prize of $1,000.
d. It is our immense joy to announce that you have been chosen as the winner of the City Photography Contest for the current year.
e. Should you have any inquiries regarding the delivery process, please reach out to our organizing committee.
Yours sincerely,
questions.explain: Trình tự một email thông báo trúng giải: (d) Thông báo tin vui trúng giải -> (b) Khen ngợi bài thi -> (c) Chi tiết giải thưởng -> (a) Hướng dẫn cách nhận giải -> (e) Thông tin liên hệ nếu có thắc mắc.

questions.stem:
Choose the best arrangement of utterances or sentences to make a cohesive and coherent exchange or text.

a. Guest: Here you go. I appreciate your assistance.
b. Guest: I reserved a table for two this evening, but I cannot find the text message.
c. Host: Please provide your phone number and I will verify it right away.
questions.explain: Hội thoại logic: (b) Khách hàng trình bày vấn đề (đặt bàn nhưng không thấy tin nhắn) -> (c) Lễ tân yêu cầu số điện thoại để kiểm tra -> (a) Khách hàng đưa số điện thoại và cảm ơn.

questions.stem:
Choose the best arrangement of utterances or sentences to make a cohesive and coherent exchange or text.

a. This urban agricultural method, however, involves substantial initial costs, as every facility needs specialized lighting to grow crops.
b. Vertical farming has emerged as a crucial innovation in modern agriculture, altering how communities secure their food sources sustainably.
c. The stacked structures provide benefits, such as maximizing land usage or reducing transportation distances with local harvests.
d. Anyone considering funding vertical farms must objectively balance the promise of year-round yields against the financial burden required to maintain indoor climates.
e. A poorly designed ventilation system or an inadequate watering schedule has, in numerous documented instances, caused entire crop cycles to fail unexpectedly.
questions.explain: Đoạn văn nghị luận logic: (b) Giới thiệu mô hình Vertical farming -> (c) Lợi ích của mô hình -> (a) Tuy nhiên, mô hình này có chi phí cao (tính từ nối "however") -> (e) Đưa ra ví dụ về sự cố rủi ro -> (d) Lời khuyên/Kết luận.

questions.stem:
Choose the best arrangement of utterances or sentences to make a cohesive and coherent exchange or text.

a. David: What makes you think that?
b. David: I have been thinking about adopting a rescue dog. What is your opinion?
c. David: I appreciate it. I will ponder on it.
d. Clara: The reality is, your daily routine will not be too disrupted if you plan well.
e. Clara: If I were in your shoes, I would get a pet right after moving into the new house.
questions.explain: Hội thoại logic: (b) David nêu ý định nhận nuôi chó -> (e) Clara khuyên thời điểm thích hợp để nhận nuôi -> (a) David hỏi lý do -> (d) Clara giải thích lý do -> (c) David cảm ơn và nói sẽ suy nghĩ thêm.

questions.stem:
Choose the best arrangement of utterances or sentences to make a cohesive and coherent exchange or text.

a. Initial statistics from the pilot phase showed a twenty percent drop in office overheads and significantly higher employee satisfaction across departments.
b. Staff members working remotely received a stipend, with the saved budget redirected toward digital infrastructure and training.
c. Decades of traditional office culture had made the daily routine in Techville the most rigid in the industry.
d. The positive results indicated that the flexible model would be introduced to other branches.
e. The corporate leaders adopted a straightforward yet debated strategy: enforcing a hybrid work schedule.
questions.explain: Trình tự sự việc: (c) Nêu vấn đề (văn hóa làm việc cứng nhắc) -> (e) Đưa ra giải pháp (áp dụng lịch làm việc hybrid) -> (b) Chi tiết của giải pháp -> (a) Kết quả tích cực -> (d) Hướng phát triển mở rộng mô hình.

questions.stem: Choose the best option for blank (13).

a huge portion of whose energy is dedicated
whose energy is hugely dedicated to dedicating
who are dedicated to taking a huge portion of their energy

questions.stem: Choose the best option for blank (14).
opts: You comprehend that it is past nothing at all
Past your comprehension, that is zero
Beyond that, you comprehend very little
Past that, very little is incomprehensible to you
questions.explain: Phù hợp với ngữ cảnh đang phân tích về ảo tưởng sự bận rộn: "Ngoài điều đó ra, bạn hiểu được rất ít về năng suất thực sự của họ".

questions.stem: Choose the best option for blank (15).
opts: so we alternatively lean on their observable habits
alternatively they lean on the habits that are observable
alternatively of their reliable observable habits
yet they lean reliable on the observable habits alternatively
questions.explain: Vì không ai trưng bày biểu đồ làm việc sâu sắc của họ, "nên (so) chúng ta đành phải dựa vào (lean on) những thói quen có thể quan sát được".

questions.stem: Choose the best option for blank (16).
opts: Truly, actual productivity is promoted as the rejection of deep work itself
Nevertheless, the truth is that deep productivity rejects promoting itself
Deep productivity itself, in truth, is promoted to reject to be deep
Deep promotions are, consequently, the rejection of actual productivity itself
questions.explain: "Nevertheless" thể hiện sự tương phản với câu trước (văn hóa công sở tôn vinh vẻ ngoài bận rộn). Sự thật là năng suất làm việc sâu (deep productivity) lại từ chối việc tự phô trương.

questions.stem: The word compromised in paragraph 1 is closest in meaning to ______.
questions.explain: "Compromised" trong ngữ cảnh bảo mật dữ liệu nghĩa là bị rò rỉ, bị lộ (exposed).

questions.stem: According to paragraph 1, the vulnerabilities of digital convenience are ______.
opts: estimated based on the direct monetary input given for software
influenced by the subscription value of the platforms themselves
minor since these applications require virtually no human intervention
existent whether or not malicious intent is involved in using these services
questions.explain: Dựa vào câu: "...even when utilized without malicious intent" (ngay cả khi được sử dụng mà không có ý đồ xấu).

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT implied in paragraph 2?
opts: GPS route sharing and absolute anonymity cannot be maintained simultaneously on the fitness tracker.
The privacy cost of sharing locations involves personal details that are exposed.
Health monitoring and social sharing offer identical digital protections for the user.
The hidden significance linked to health data may go beyond its immediate use for fitness tracking.
questions.explain: Câu này KHÔNG được ngụ ý, vì bài đọc nói rõ hai tính năng này có mức độ an toàn trái ngược nhau ("conflicting safety levels").

questions.stem:
Where in paragraph 3 does the following sentence best fit?
Such covert compromises become obvious only when one stops to examine what the algorithms were secretly accumulating.
questions.explain: Câu được chèn vào tóm tắt lại các "covert compromises" (sự đánh đổi ngầm) nên vị trí tốt nhất là ở cuối đoạn 3 [IV], sau khi đã liệt kê hàng loạt các ví dụ về đánh đổi quyền riêng tư.

questions.stem: Which of the following best summarises paragraph 3?
opts: Lawmakers should take the regulation of social media into account.
Actions that are viewed as safe might actually entail hidden concessions.
Long-term digital security mostly outweighs instant virtual connectivity.
Technological advancement plans should be suspended when privacy breaches happen.
questions.explain: Đoạn 3 đưa ra các ví dụ về việc những hành động tưởng chừng vô hại (như tải ảnh, đồng bộ danh bạ) thực chất đều tiềm ẩn những sự đánh đổi về quyền riêng tư.

questions.stem: The word They in paragraph 4 refers to ______.
questions.explain: "They" thay thế cho chủ ngữ "Regulations" ở câu ngay phía trước ("Regulations that acknowledge this...").

questions.stem: What conclusion can be drawn from paragraph 4?
opts: Concealing the privacy costs is mandatory once an application proves to have a useful feature.
Laws controlling data collection are fundamentally detrimental to innovation.
Harm induced by deliberate negligence regarding digital footprints is irreversible.
Evaluating privacy costs guarantees that digital engagement is actually worthwhile.
questions.explain: Đoạn cuối nhấn mạnh việc cân nhắc chi phí quyền riêng tư sẽ giúp đảm bảo rằng những công nghệ chúng ta sử dụng thực sự xứng đáng với những gì ta phải đánh đổi.

questions.stem: Which of the following is true according to the passage?
opts: Privacy costs are dictated by the subscription fees for digital services.
Social connectivity is the main standard for assessing fitness applications.
The real worth of a platform is assessed not only by its practical utility.
Keeping a device on standby is digitally safe since it shares no information.
questions.explain: Dựa vào câu: "It is a matter of whether the utility surpasses the significance of what must be surrendered." (Giá trị thực sự không chỉ nằm ở tiện ích mà còn ở việc so sánh nó với những gì phải đánh đổi).

questions.stem: Which of the following can be inferred from the passage?
opts: Regulations that demand transparency are meant to limit the growth of digital technology.
The advantages of digital convenience broadly outshine the value of protected personal data.
Users are compelled to pay for the data losses in exchange for digital utility.
The overall benefits delivered by digital platforms ignoring privacy costs tend to be exaggerated.
questions.explain: Có thể suy luận rằng nếu không tính đến "chi phí quyền riêng tư" (privacy costs), chúng ta sẽ có xu hướng đánh giá quá cao (exaggerate) những lợi ích mà các nền tảng kỹ thuật số mang lại.

questions.stem: Which of the following would be the best title for the passage?
opts: Data Protection: Entering a New Phase
questions.explain: Tiêu đề phản ánh bao quát toàn bài: Sự kết nối số và việc phải cân nhắc những sự đánh đổi (quyền riêng tư).

questions.stem: Choose the best option for blank (27).
questions.explain: Idiom "up for grabs" nghĩa là có sẵn cho mọi người tranh tài, ứng tuyển.

questions.stem: Choose the best option for blank (28).
questions.explain: Cấu trúc so sánh kép "The + so sánh hơn..., the + so sánh hơn...". Tính từ "favorable" dài vần nên dùng "the more favorable".

questions.stem: Choose the best option for blank (29).
questions.explain: Cần một trạng từ bổ sung thông tin (Hơn nữa, ngoài ra), "Furthermore" phù hợp ngữ cảnh nối tiếp các lợi ích.

questions.stem: Choose the best option for blank (30).
questions.explain: "Neither role demands prior background since..." mang nghĩa "Không vai trò nào yêu cầu kinh nghiệm trước đó bởi vì..." (phù hợp logic vì sau đó giải thích là họ sẽ được đào tạo).

questions.stem: Choose the best option for blank (31).
questions.explain: Yêu cầu bắt buộc trong quy trình ứng tuyển: Đơn đăng ký "phải" (must) được gửi trước ngày 15/11.

questions.stem: Choose the best option for blank (32).
questions.explain: Cần một tính từ tích cực ghép với "prospect" (viễn cảnh/cơ hội). "Brilliant prospect" mang nghĩa cơ hội tuyệt vời.

questions.stem: In paragraph 1, the writer is ______.
opts: describing a recent modification in the way consumers count calories
disputing a long-standing belief about nutritional health
advocating the use of new metrics in evaluating physical fitness
doubting the importance of a healthy diet in everyday life
questions.explain: Ở đoạn 1, tác giả bác bỏ niềm tin cũ rằng sức khỏe dinh dưỡng chỉ phụ thuộc vào việc đếm calo, và chỉ ra sự chuyển dịch sang việc đánh giá chất lượng thực phẩm.

questions.stem: The word those in paragraph 2 refers to ______.
questions.explain: "...individuals consuming whole foods... than those eating..." đại từ "those" thay thế cho "individuals" (những người).

questions.stem: Which of the following best paraphrases the underlined sentence in paragraph 2?
opts: The interaction between food types and the digestive system, along with the caloric number, accounts for the discrepancy in metabolic responses.
What accounts for the discrepancy in metabolic responses is the way different foods interact with digestion, rather than just the calorie count.
The discrepancy in metabolic responses is caused by the calorie count rather than the interaction of food types with the digestive system.
Irrespective of the food type, the effects on metabolism show minimal variation provided that calories are counted accurately.
questions.explain: Câu gốc mang ý: Lời giải thích liên quan nhiều đến cách thực phẩm tương tác với hệ tiêu hóa, chứ không phải do bản thân lượng calo. Đáp án đúng truyền tải chính xác nhất ý này.

questions.stem: The word pivotal in paragraph 3 is OPPOSITE in meaning to ______.
questions.explain: "Pivotal" nghĩa là cực kỳ quan trọng, mang tính then chốt. Từ trái nghĩa là "trivial" (tầm thường, không quan trọng).

questions.stem: The word careless in paragraph 4 is CLOSEST in meaning to ______.
questions.explain: "Careless" (bất cẩn, không chú ý) đồng nghĩa với "negligent".

questions.stem: Which of the following statements would the writer NOT agree with?
opts: Whole foods and processed foods resulted in different degrees of metabolic responses.
The slow speed of digesting whole foods proves to be a physiological advantage.
The general public is conscious of the alteration in how food processing is perceived.
Health organizations generally disagree on the establishment of dietary guidelines.
questions.explain: Tác giả KHÔNG đồng ý với nhận định này vì trong đoạn 1 có ghi sự thay đổi này diễn ra "unbeknownst to the general public" (công chúng không hề hay biết).

questions.stem: In which paragraph does the writer refer to a biological mechanism?
questions.explain: Thuật ngữ sinh học "the thermic effect of food" (hiệu ứng nhiệt của thực phẩm) và cơ chế tiêu hóa dần dần được nhắc đến rõ ràng ở Đoạn 3.

questions.stem: In which paragraph does the writer caution against an absolute assumption?
questions.explain: Ở đoạn 4, tác giả cảnh báo không nên cực đoan: "It would be inaccurate, naturally, to assert that all calorie counting is completely useless..." (Sẽ là không chính xác nếu cho rằng mọi việc đếm calo đều vô dụng...).
